title: Hearty Brazilian Potato Wrap
description: A jammy and tender Brazilian dish featuring small potatoes, tadka, and anti-inflammatory friendly ingredients, all wrapped in a lotus leaf
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large pan, heat the coconut oil over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger and cook for an additional 1 minute.
Add the tadka spice mix and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the diced potatoes, salt, turmeric, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20 minutes, or until the potatoes are tender.
While the potatoes are cooking, prepare the lotus leaves by rinsing them in cold water and patting them dry.
To assemble the wraps, place a portion of the potato mixture onto the center of a lotus leaf and fold the leaf to enclose.
Place the wraps on a baking sheet and bake for 10 minutes, or until the leaves are tender and slightly caramelized.
